subject: Verify logger-to-package linkage
unresolved_conditions: Specify a feasible linkage check and acceptance criteria that establish reliable attribution of logger records to selected packages throughout the monitored stages.
rationale: Checking attribution supports reliable evidence comparison and addresses the target's missing package tracking. It is a prerequisite to the transferred comparison, not itself a diagnostic comparison. The unspecified method and acceptance criteria leave its adequacy unresolved; the proposal does not establish successful linkage.
